stages.label: Whole car
stages.text: The selected front-left wheel contains one of four wheel brakes. The engine is behind the seats; the hydraulic source is at the front.

stages.label: Connections
stages.text: The body lifts away to reveal a schematic hydraulic connection from the front-mounted master cylinder to all four wheel brakes.

stages.label: At the wheel
stages.text: The camera moves to the front-left brake. The wheel is pulled aside so the disc and fixed caliper can be seen.

stages.label: Exploded
stages.text: The wheel, disc, two pads, four pistons and one-piece caliper separate for inspection. This separation is explanatory, not a workshop disassembly sequence.

parts.name: wheel
parts.label: Wheel
parts.text: The wheel bolts to the hub. Its spokes leave space around the brake and allow a view of the assembly.

parts.name: disc
parts.label: Brake disc
parts.text: The front disc's nominal envelope is 318 mm in diameter and 28 mm thick. Two friction faces enclose the ventilation gap.

parts.name: inner-pad
parts.label: Inner pad
parts.text: The inboard pad presses against one face of the rotating disc.

parts.name: outer-pad
parts.label: Outer pad
parts.text: The outboard pad presses against the opposite face. The pair creates the clamping action.

parts.name: caliper
parts.label: Caliper body
parts.text: The fixed monobloc caliper body stays in one piece. It carries the reaction forces as pistons push both pads inward.

parts.name: pistons
parts.label: Four pistons
parts.text: Two pistons act from each side. Their motion converts hydraulic pressure into force on the pads.

parts.name: hub
parts.label: Hub
parts.text: The hub connects the rotating assembly to the wheel bearing and suspension. The drawing omits many fasteners and supporting parts.
